name: Watris
author: Bruno Garcia
description: A Tetris-style falling block game: rotate and drop the pieces to complete lines, with level, score and best score on screen.

descriptions.en: A Tetris-style falling block game: rotate and drop the pieces to complete lines, with level, score and best score on screen.
descriptions.it: Un gioco di blocchi in stile Tetris: ruota e fai cadere i pezzi per completare le righe, con livello, punteggio e record sullo schermo.
